title: Unexpectedly lost connection to active Pod on updating to 2.8.2.14-dev
body:
AndroidAPS 2.8.2.14-dev
Build: a458ad5fd
Flavor: fullrelease

**Problem description**
Shortly after "in-place" updating to this build, AAPS unexpectedly lost all communication with the DASH Pod.
DASH overview reported continuously connecting/handshaking/connecting without being able to connect.
Seeing "CommandReadStatus - READSTATUS Pump driver changed"

* Tried update-installing, re-importing settings for current Pod.
* Unable to regain connection with the active Pod.
* Trying to activate new a Pod resulted in a "Pod not detected" error.

Finally was able to activate a new Pod by:
1. Uninstall AAPS, reset BT cache, restart phone
2. Install AAPS while importing **settings for a previous last-know-good DASH**
3. Deactivate/discard old DASH Pod
4. Activate new DASH Pod

**Additional information**
Not sure if this was just a glitch or a problem with the update-install. Have no idea.

**See logfile:**
*Time of first signs of communication problems:* **12:17:11.352**
